title: Extension of normalized tensor-Hom values to derived objects
statement: For a scheme X with chosen derived category, let t be a family Hom(K,RHom(L,M)) to Hom(K tensor^L L,M) satisfying the representative localization equation for every K-flat P, arbitrary complexes L,M and chain map phi:P to Hom(L,I(M)). There exists a family s agreeing with t on precisely those normalized inputs and compatible with every isomorphism in K,L,M. Arbitrary values of t outside those inputs need not be preserved.

source.place: Tag 08DJ; sites-cohomology.tex Tags 0A90, 0A96; verified at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/08DJ, https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0A90, https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0A96

proof.text: For every derived input choose K-flat representatives P and Lc of K and L and a complex Mc representing M. The Hom complex Hom(Lc,I(Mc)) is K-injective. Lift the transported derived morphism first through the bijection on homotopy-category maps and then through the full quotient functor to a chain map phi. Naturality of quotientCompQhIso yields exactly the normalized input equation. This coverage step is proved as the private helper normalizedInput_exists.

Use the normalized comparison theorem for the localized chain evaluations. A generic proved helper extendNormalizedValues forms the relation whose witnesses are normalized representatives and their three isomorphisms to the desired objects. Coverage makes every fiber nonempty. Comparing two witnesses by their composite representative isomorphisms and applying normalized comparison gives equality of outputs after cancelling invertible tensor and target maps; thus every fiber is a singleton. Choose that unique output. Identity witnesses establish normalization, and composing a witness with the three given isomorphisms establishes transport; uniqueness supplies the desired equation. The actual evaluation values use schemeTensorHomUncurry, whose chain-map construction uses the differential-compatibility theorem.

Apply this helper to the actual normalized chain inputs and localized schemeTensorHomUncurry values. Its normalization equation, followed by the reverse of ht, gives agreement with t precisely on the inputs in the agreement clause. Its transport equation is the second required conjunct. The family is selected only within the theorem proof, after uniqueness has been proved; no definition chooses an undetermined existence witness.

theorem exists_tensorHomUncurry_descent_extension (X : Scheme.{u})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    (t : ∀ K L M : schemeDerivedCategory X,
      (K ⟶ (derivedInternalHom (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.toRingedSpace)
        X.toRingedSpace.sheaf).obj (op L, M)) → (K ⊗ L ⟶ M))
    (ht : ∀ (P L M : CochainComplex
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ),
        P.IsKFlat →
        ∀ φ : P ⟶ homComplex (R := X.sheaf) L
            ((schemeHomKInjectiveResolution X).obj M),
          t (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) (DerivedCategory.Q.obj L) (DerivedCategory.Q.obj M)
              (DerivedCategory.Q.map φ ≫
                (schemeDerivedInternalHomResolutionIso X L M).inv) =
            pullbackTensorModelMap X P L ≫
              DerivedCategory.Q.map (schemeTensorHomUncurry X P L M φ) ≫
                schemeHomResolutionInverse X M) :
    letI := schemeDerivedTensorMonoidal X
    ∃ s : ∀ K L M : schemeDerivedCategory X,
      (K ⟶ (derivedInternalHom (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.toRingedSpace)
        X.toRingedSpace.sheaf).obj (op L, M)) → (K ⊗ L ⟶ M),
      (∀ (P L M : CochainComplex
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ),
        P.IsKFlat →
        ∀ φ : P ⟶ homComplex (R := X.sheaf) L
            ((schemeHomKInjectiveResolution X).obj M),
          s (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) (DerivedCategory.Q.obj L) (DerivedCategory.Q.obj M)
              (DerivedCategory.Q.map φ ≫
                (schemeDerivedInternalHomResolutionIso X L M).inv) =
            t (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) (DerivedCategory.Q.obj L) (DerivedCategory.Q.obj M)
              (DerivedCategory.Q.map φ ≫
                (schemeDerivedInternalHomResolutionIso X L M).inv)) ∧
    ∀ (K K' L L' M M' : schemeDerivedCategory X)
      (a : K' ≅ K) (b : L' ≅ L) (c : M ≅ M')
      (f : K ⟶ (derivedInternalHom (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.toRingedSpace)
        X.toRingedSpace.sheaf).obj (op L, M)),
      s K' L' M' (a.hom ≫ f ≫
        (derivedInternalHom (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.toRingedSpace)
          X.toRingedSpace.sheaf).map (b.hom.op, c.hom)) =
        (a.hom ⊗ₘ b.hom) ≫ s K L M f ≫ c.hom
